market_summary: Major macro assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, BTCUSD) are experiencing strong downward expansion below their respective session Value Area Lows and VWAP baselines, currently consolidating into session lows near lower ATR bands without fresh RVOL confirmation. Concurrently, US100 rallied into positive dampening Call Wall resistance (28431), prompting mean-reversion pressure. Across all instruments, risk-reward at current extremes is unfavorable, favoring patience for retests or mean-reversion pullbacks.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (3917.46) and below POC (3978.13), indicating strong negative value area distribution. CVD is BEARISH at -8.25 supporting downward momentum, active in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price remains deeply below VWAP (3940.64) and EMA50 (3927.13), pressing against the lower ATR band (3871.65). RVOL is 0.91 (no yellow spike on recent bar, though prior spikes confirm strong selling pressure). The market is testing Session Low (3852.35). Under POSITIVE_DAMPENING GEX regime, dealers hedge against moves, with price currently hovering directly at Gamma Flip (3866.39) and well above Put Wall #1 (3813.76). With price pausing right at the Gamma Flip and lacking fresh RVOL expansion, entering short here risks a dampening bounce toward VWAP.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at Gamma Flip and lower ATR band

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.10760) and well below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (+355) diverging slightly from the lower prices during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Trend is strictly bearish below downward-sloping VWAP (1.10822) and EMA50 (1.10826). The candles are hovering around the lower ATR band (1.10580) and testing Session Low support at 1.10533. RVOL is modest at 1.169 without yellow climax confirmation. With price consolidating directly on top of key support (1.10533) and neutral cumulative delta divergence, selling into the low ATR boundary carries poor edge.

Price is below VAL (1.32545) and below POC (1.32731) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is BEARISH at -9,698 agreeing with the heavy sell-off. Price is well below downward-slanted VWAP (1.32592) and EMA50 (1.32598). It is hugging the lower ATR band (1.32302) just above Session Low support at 1.32210. Current RVOL is 1.117 without an immediate yellow volume spike on the signal candle, showing potential exhaustion near the session floor. Entering short into the immediate support of 1.32210 without an upside pullback provides unfavorable asymmetry.
signals.level_event: retest of Session Low after breakdown

signals.rationale: Price expanded well above VAH (28218.78) and POC (28122.95) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is NEUTRAL (+2.81) with flat volume delta. Price is comfortably above VWAP (28148.18) and EMA50 (28175.91) but tested the upper ATR band (28444.00) after sweeping up to Session High (28550.97). Note that under POSITIVE_DAMPENING GEX regime above Gamma Flip (28225.06), price is currently rejecting directly off Call Wall #1 (28431.02, strength 0.91, OI aligned). In positive dampening, dealers cap momentum at call walls and enforce mean reversion. Although US100 rarely shows yellow RVOL spikes (RVOL 1.047 is standard), buying directly into or under Call Wall #1 violates GEX rules.
signals.level_event: rejection at Call Wall #1 / Session High

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (72515.53) and below POC (73501.60) in NEW_YORK_SESSION. CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) confirming the extended downtrend below VWAP (72931.89) and EMA50 (72732.66).
